articles.summary: Amendment Provides Covenant Relief and Runway to Advance Its Strategic Review ROGERS, Ark., June 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - America’s Car-Mart, Inc. (NASDAQ: CRMT) (“Car-Mart” or the “Company”), today announced that it has entered into an amendment (the “Amendment”) to its Credit and Guaranty Agreement with Silver Point Finance, LLC, as Administrative Agent, and the Company’s lenders, as part of the Company’s proactive efforts to preserve liquidity and advance its ongoing strategic alternatives process. The Amendment provides the Company with covenant relief and a defined path forward as it works with its advisors to complete a review of strategic alternatives. articles.title: America’s Car-Mart, Inc. Announces Agreement with Lenders to Support Ongoing Strategic Review Process
